text: 紫金矿业晚间公告，2026年10月22日，公司全资子公司紫金黄金（集团）有限公司（下称“紫金黄金”）收到中国证券登记结算有限责任公司出具的《证券过户登记确认书》，确认赤峰吉隆黄金矿业集团股份有限公司（下称“赤峰黄金”）原控股股东、实际控制人李金阳女士及其一致行动人浙江瀚丰创业投资合伙企业（有限合伙）合计持有的赤峰黄金241,925,746股A股股份已全部过户登记至紫金黄金名下。
text_en: Zijin Mining announced in an evening filing that on October 22, 2026, its wholly owned subsidiary Zijin Gold (Group) Co., Ltd. ("Zijin Gold") received a "Securities Transfer Registration Confirmation" issued by China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited, confirming that the 241,925,746 A-shares of Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining Group Co., Ltd. ("Chifeng Gold") held in total by Ms. Li Jinyang, former controlling shareholder and actual controller of Chifeng Gold, and her concerted party Zhejiang Hanfeng Venture Capital Partnership (Limited Partnership) had all been transferred and registered under Zijin Gold's name.
